title: Taiwan's Taiex posts its biggest weekly gain on record, up 10%, as China and Hong Kong slip before Trump meets Xi
short: Taiwan rebounds 10% in a record week; China and Hong Kong slip
dek: Asia's chip markets bounced back after Nvidia's CEO quit. Japan rose 6.5% and Europe hit records, while China stayed cautious. Oil and gold both fell for the week.
card: Taiex +10.01% and Nikkei +6.46% for the week; Shanghai −0.41%. Brent ended at $95.84. What it means for India.
